market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have been the primary challengers to Manchester City, finishing 2nd in 2023-24 and looking strong again in 2024-25. With a deep squad and consistent manager, they remain the second-most likely team to finish exactly 2nd in 2025-26. The market's 16.5% implied probability seems too low; I estimate around 22%, giving a clear edge on Yes.
evidence_points: Arsenal finished 2nd in 2023-24 and are projected to repeat in 2024-25
Manchester City remain title favorites, but Arsenal are the strongest of the chasing pack
Betting markets for the EPL winner consistently price Arsenal as a top-3 candidate, with a fair exact-2nd likelihood around 20-25%
sources_consulted: Public data on 2024-25 EPL table and team strength assessments
General knowledge of football squad values and managerial stability
